name: Haus Mark
beschreibung: The Haus Mark in Nesselwängle is quietly located in the Tannheimer Tal, surrounded by the mountain scenery of the Allgäuer Alpen. The rooms are traditionally furnished and offer balcony, bathroom and satellite TV. The in-house restaurant serves Tiroler cuisine with regional products. In the surrounding area there are numerous hiking and cycling trails; in winter the region's ski areas attract visitors. The nearby Haldensee invites water sports in summer. The atmosphere of the house is family-like and characterized by Alpine coziness.
